text: This clip shows the owner checking a week of hours and approving it.
The owner opens the timesheets for the week. For each person and each day, they see hours punched in, hours on jobs, and shop time.
On Thursday, Technician 1 forgot to clock out. The owner opens that day, enters the clock out time, and writes a short reason.
The change is saved with the reason, so there is a record. Then the owner approves the week, and the hours are ready to send to payroll.
